info.title: CAIJ AI Legal Search API
info.description: API for intelligent legal document search with natural language queries

post.description:
Perform semantic search across legal document types, streamed over SSE.

This endpoint owns what is specific to it — authentication, the request
lock, rewriting the query from clarifications, opening the research
session, and persisting the turn. The search itself belongs to
SearchPipelineService (see services/search_pipeline_service.py for what
legislative integration and semantic analysis actually do).

When clarifications are provided, the original query is rewritten to
integrate them before the pipeline ever sees it.

SearchTypeEnum.title: SearchTypeEnum
SearchTypeEnum.description: Available search types for semantic search

query.title: Query
query.description: The search query in natural language

search_types.title: Search Types
search_types.description: Types of documents to search. If not specified, defaults to jurisprudence

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Number of top results to return per search type

include_vector_search.title: Include Vector Search
include_vector_search.description: Whether to include vector-based semantic search

filter_expression.title: Filter Expression
filter_expression.description: OData filter expression for additional filtering

search_filters.title: Search Filters
search_filters.description: List of search filters including date ranges

enable_legislative_integration.title: Enable Legislative Integration
enable_legislative_integration.description: Whether to enable legislative integration (extract cited legislation from jurisprudence and enhance ELOIS/LEGISLATION results)

use_parallel_search.title: Use Parallel Search
use_parallel_search.description: Whether to use parallel search execution for better performance

max_workers.title: Max Workers
max_workers.description: Maximum number of parallel workers for search execution (only used when use_parallel_search=True)

clarifications.title: Clarifications
clarifications.description: Optional clarifications to enhance the original query. When provided, the query will be rewritten to integrate these clarifications for better search results.

semantic_analysis.title: Semantic Analysis
semantic_analysis.description: Whether to perform semantic analysis on search results using LLM to analyze relevance and provide enhanced insights. This provides deeper analysis of result relevance to the query.

summarization.title: Summarization
summarization.description: Whether to perform summarization on search results using LLM to generate a concise executive summary.
